title: S. Giles
summary: Raleigh names S. Giles in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). A Verse was sent from heauen to S. Giles. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
